activation.intro: Switch every eligible $t(terms:project.singularLower) to Cloud-primary writes and ship the history this instance is still holding, in one queued job instead of one API call and one CLI run per $t(terms:project.singularLower).
activation.stopBody: $t(terms:project.plural) already switched stay on Temps Cloud — the switch is never rolled back. Spans already shipped are not re-sent if you resume later, and the job stops at the next chunk boundary rather than mid-batch.
activation.restricted: Bulk Cloud telemetry activation is restricted to instance administrators, so this section cannot show whether one is running. $t(terms:project.plural) can still be switched one at a time from their own telemetry settings.
activation.noJob: No activation is running. Starting one quotes every eligible $t(terms:project.singularLower) first — you see the exact span count and metered bytes before anything is sent.
activation.retryDescription: Re-quotes only the $t(terms:project.pluralLower) that failed or were skipped, and asks you to confirm the new bill before anything is sent.
activation.resumeDescription: Picks up the $t(terms:project.pluralLower) this activation never finished. Spans already acknowledged by Temps Cloud are not sent again.
activation.quotesFirst: Quotes every eligible $t(terms:project.singularLower) first. Nothing is sent until you confirm the total.
activation.notConnectedTail: Once connected, this button quotes every $t(terms:project.singularLower) — for example “12 $t(terms:project.pluralLower), 4.1 million spans, 3.2 GB” — and switches them all after you confirm.

status.aborted: An instance-wide condition stopped this activation. $t(terms:project.plural) it never reached are still queued, so resuming picks up where it left off — nothing already paid for is sent twice.
status.pending: Not started yet — nothing has been sent for this $t(terms:project.singularLower).

status.noSkipReason: The instance recorded no reason for skipping this $t(terms:project.singularLower).
